verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability is an observability platform, not a coding agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The natural-language telemetry interaction, the AI SRE feature, llms.txt and the markdown docs are adjacent capabilities and do not let an external agent connect via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
